page.overview:
Who is Unidentified Sith Lord?

An individual served as a Sith Lord of One Sith and the Galactic Empire ruled by Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Krayt. The Sith Lord was in charge of the planet Iridonia and its colony worlds and ordered the transformation of the colony planet Feldrona into an Imperial prison world.
